name: Henan Yuneng Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Henan Yuneng Holdings Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, invests in, develops, generates, and sells electricity in China. It operates through Power, Coal, and Other segments. The company offers electricity and heat, including biomass thermal power, heating, wind power, photovoltaic power, and other power supply; and equipment maintenance, overhaul services, carbon asset trading, and other services to power generation companies, as well as sells power generation by-products. It also purchases and sells coal, selection, storage, transportation, and other services; and provides accounts receivable factoring financing services.
